subject.title: feat(cron): emit session.maintenance.pruned diagnostic event on reaper pruning

question: Should `session.maintenance.pruned` become a supported additive event visible through the shared diagnostic listener contract, with corresponding OTEL and Prometheus metric names?
rationale: The branch changes an externally consumable diagnostic-event union despite describing the work as having no SDK surface, so maintainers must confirm that this event and its names are intended long-lived contracts.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Accept the new event and metric names as supported observability surface, then require direct exporter proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it exporter-internal
options.body: Introduce or use a core-owned internal telemetry seam so external diagnostic listeners do not receive a new public event variant.

options.title: Pause the telemetry addition
options.body: Leave the linked enhancement open until maintainers select a stable event taxonomy and exporter contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the new event and metric names as supported observability surface, then require direct exporter proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history trail is the session-reaper feature and maintenance work this telemetry observes.
